description: This is a Java class defining a custom exception for indicating that a floating rate was not found in the system, extending a generic resource not found exception.

classes.name: FloatingRateNotFoundException
classes.description: A custom exception thrown when a floating rate entity cannot be found, extending a platform resource not found exception.

methods.description: Constructor creating exception with message indicating the floating rate with given id does not exist.
